title: Named third-party Sarvam AI products and deployments
scope: Public web evidence of actual Sarvam use. This is a precedent inventory, not a clinical validation or live product audit.

coverageAudit.strongestHealthcareEvidence: HealthPlix HALO has a detailed vendor case study with named customer attribution, actual STT model and workflow. NHA is a health-access outreach pilot, not a diagnostic product.
coverageAudit.whatWasVerified: Explicit Sarvam attribution and described workflows on opened primary vendor, builder, institution or repository pages.
coverageAudit.whatWasNotVerified: Customer contracts, paying usage, API traffic, current deployment health, independent clinical outcomes, privacy compliance or the accuracy of marketing metrics.
coverageAudit.scarcity: No evidence found for 100 distinct real Sarvam medical products. The requested 100 medical use cases must be presented as proposed applications, separately from these named precedents.
coverageAudit.evidenceBias: Most mature examples are Sarvam-published customer stories. Named customer quotes improve attribution but are not independent audits.
coverageAudit.countingRules: One organization/product is counted once even when it has multiple workflows. Sarvam's own APIs, Indus, Kaze, Edge and announced partnerships are not counted as third-party customer deployments.
coverageAudit.sourceCaution: A search result for a newer SBI Life SPARK story returned 404 when opened, so its added claims were excluded. Engageo is Ritu's builder and is counted once; its homepage has conflicting clinic counts, so no customer count is adopted.
coverageAudit.clinicalBoundary: Use evidence for language access, documentation and coordination patterns. It does not establish that an LLM may diagnose, prescribe, choose opioid doses or replace palliative clinicians.

examples.name: HealthPlix — H.A.L.O
examples.evidencePublisher: Sarvam, with named HealthPlix CPO attribution
examples.problem: Code-mixed consultations create typing and documentation work.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Speech to Text, Streaming V2.5.
examples.generativeMechanism: Sarvam transcribes; HealthPlix's proprietary clinical models structure the transcript. The source does not attribute clinical reasoning to Sarvam.
examples.workflow: Record consultation; transcribe; draft structured medical record; doctor reviews.
examples.reportedOutcome: Sarvam's customer story reports 50,000+ HALO consultations, 97%+ prescription accuracy and about five minutes saved per consultation.
examples.limitation: Vendor/customer-reported metrics; benchmark method and independent clinical outcomes are not established. Do not generalize prescription accuracy to other specialties or Sahara.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Draft goals-of-care notes from consented conversation, preserve speaker provenance and require clinician correction before sharing.

examples.name: National Health Authority — Ayushman Vay Vandana outreach
examples.productUrlNote: Programme deployment, not a separate public app.
examples.problem: Older citizens may lack scheme awareness, smartphones or confidence with forms.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Samvaad conversational voice-agent platform over basic telephone calls.
examples.generativeMechanism: Adaptive multilingual conversations explain programme information, answer questions and capture enrolment interest.
examples.workflow: Outbound call; explain benefits; respond in local language; record intent; route to enrolment support.
examples.reportedOutcome: Sarvam reports 1.4 million unique citizens reached in six days and a correlated 42% increase in daily enrolment versus the preceding 30 days.
examples.limitation: Source explicitly distinguishes correlation from causation. This was an outreach pilot, not treatment or verified clinical advice.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Voice can connect families to existing palliative services and benefits without requiring app literacy; retain staffed follow-up.

examples.name: Engageo — Ritu clinic receptionist
examples.evidencePublisher: Atul Hooda, builder; corroborating Engageo product site and technical blog
examples.evidenceDateNote: LinkedIn shows relative age, not an exact verified publication date. Technical blog is dated 2026-05-26.
examples.problem: Clinics miss inbound patient calls and appointment requests.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Builder explicitly says production STT and TTS; homepage explicitly credits Sarvam speech/voice.
examples.generativeMechanism: Conversational receptionist answers clinic questions and collects booking intent; speech models handle Indic conversation.
examples.workflow: Unanswered call forwards; agent answers; calendar booking; WhatsApp confirmation and reminders.
examples.reportedOutcome: Founder claims real-clinic production use. No quantitative benefit is adopted because deployment counts on the homepage conflict.
examples.limitation: Not independently audited. Builder's technical blog describes accent, language-switch and backchannel failures and says a quantitative outcome study was in progress.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Reduce missed care-navigation calls, but implement reliable calendar writes, duplicate protection, disclosure and human handoff.

examples.name: Medilite AI
examples.problem: Neighbourhood clinics juggle intake, queues and typed notes.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Product site explicitly labels its AI voice scribe as Sarvam-powered; exact model/API unspecified.
examples.generativeMechanism: Spoken consultation is turned into Chief Complaint, Assessment and Plan drafts.
examples.workflow: WhatsApp intake; live queue; doctor records voice; doctor reviews and edits notes; discharge workflow.
examples.reportedOutcome: No verified adoption or numerical outcome found.
examples.limitation: Opened product website establishes the builder's claim only; no live patient workflow, named customer, clinical accuracy or production traffic was checked.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Voice drafts should land directly in a reviewable care record rather than create another standalone chatbot.

examples.name: MedCore
examples.problem: Hospitals use disconnected administrative and documentation tools.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Website explicitly identifies India-region Sarvam ASR for multilingual transcription and ambient scribe; exact model unspecified.
examples.generativeMechanism: ASR feeds SOAP drafts and a broader agent workflow; the page does not establish Sarvam as every downstream reasoning model.
examples.workflow: Call or consultation; transcribe; produce note/queue action; human handoff with context.
examples.reportedOutcome: No Sarvam-specific independently verified result adopted.
examples.limitation: Marketing assertions, testimonials, clinical automation and compliance claims were not audited. The page alternates between eight and ten language claims.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: A care-team inbox needs transcript context and an accountable handoff, not isolated AI answers.

examples.name: Pood / Podd Health Assistant
examples.problem: Typing routine food and vital logs is cumbersome.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Site credits Sarvam STT/TTS and Bulbul V3 for Hindi speech. Bulbul is the TTS component, not evidence of speech recognition by itself.
examples.generativeMechanism: Sarvam speech surrounds an OpenAI/LangGraph tool-calling agent; LocusGraph stores structured memory.
examples.workflow: ESP32 captures voice; cloud backend interprets; tool logs food/vitals; spoken reply.
examples.reportedOutcome: Public website and linked source repository exist; no deployment or clinical outcome verified.
examples.limitation: Prototype evidence. Repository README differs from the marketed architecture and has an unfinished licence placeholder; do not assume its advertised MIT status.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: A spoken symptom diary is feasible; request confirmation for extracted values and separate reported symptoms from measured vitals.

examples.name: RK Hospital Voice Agent — SrinathS-21 repository
examples.problem: Multilingual telephone appointment booking.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: README specifies Saarika V2.5 STT, Bulbul V2 TTS and Sarvam-M, with Twilio, MongoDB, Sheets and Gemini File Search.
examples.generativeMechanism: Streaming speech-to-text to LLM to text-to-speech, with a separate hospital information retrieval path.
examples.workflow: Phone conversation; collect appointment details; consult hospital knowledge; persist booking; reminder call.
examples.reportedOutcome: Source code and architecture are public; no verified hospital deployment or measured sub-second latency.
examples.limitation: Repository description calls it a POC. README's production-ready and latency labels are claims, not completed integration or performance verification.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Useful architecture reference for booking, but every promised booking must be confirmed by the actual scheduling service.

examples.name: Gram Vaani — Riya
examples.problem: Private health questions.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Voice Agents programme.
examples.generativeMechanism: Health/wellness dialogue.
examples.workflow: Consented voice questions.
examples.reportedOutcome: Report lists 2,500 unique users.
examples.limitation: Pilot; no clinical validation.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Private conversation needs escalation.

examples.name: CEGIS — IFA high-frequency monitoring
examples.productUrlNote: Programme deployment, not a verified public app.
examples.problem: Supplement receipt/consumption gaps.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Voice Agents programme.
examples.generativeMechanism: Conversational monitoring.
examples.workflow: Ask pregnant/lactating beneficiaries about IFA access and problems.
examples.reportedOutcome: Report lists 8,500 unique beneficiaries.
examples.limitation: Self-reported access; no clinical efficacy.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Follow-ups must trigger staff action.

examples.name: Mahindra Finance voice agents
examples.productUrlNote: Internal customer and employee calling workflows.
examples.evidencePublisher: Sarvam, with named Mahindra Finance CEO attribution
examples.problem: Reach dispersed customers and field employees in their language.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Voice agents on Sarvam's platform; Mahindra AI's own predictive models and orchestration.
examples.generativeMechanism: Predictions become spoken contextual conversations, followed by custom call analysis.
examples.workflow: Campaign selection; multilingual call; capture response; integrate downstream CRM and servicing actions.
examples.reportedOutcome: Customer story reports over one crore calls across twelve languages, sales, collections and employee engagement.
examples.limitation: Reported scale is not independently verified. Financial collection tactics should not be copied into vulnerable-patient engagement.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Use contextual follow-up backed by operational records and real staff actions; respect the family's preferred contact time.

examples.name: IIM Udaipur bilingual BBA curriculum
examples.evidencePublisher: Sarvam, with IIM Udaipur faculty attribution; programme corroborated by IIM
examples.problem: Produce Hindi and English lectures without recording both.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Transcription, translation and voice-preserving dubbing workflow; model names unspecified.
examples.generativeMechanism: Generate reviewed English script and dubbed speech from a Hindi recording.
examples.workflow: Faculty records; transcript and translation reviewed for academic meaning; dub, synchronize and release.
examples.reportedOutcome: Case study reports English versions already receiving at least half the views of Hindi originals; annual content volume is a requirement, not all completed delivery.
examples.limitation: Educational metrics are not proof of medical translation safety or complete three-year curriculum processing.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Publish clinician-approved regional-language explanations; review meaning before generating patient audio.

examples.name: Equal AI Call Screening Assistant
examples.evidencePublisher: Sarvam, with Equal CEO attribution; product site and store listing corroboration
examples.problem: People cannot identify which incoming calls matter.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Speech Recognition APIs; Saaras V3 primary model, streaming/batch, diarization and transliteration.
examples.generativeMechanism: Sarvam supplies transcripts; Equal's assistant converses, identifies intent and returns summary/recording.
examples.workflow: Assistant answers caller; determines reason; supplies transcript and summary; user can take over.
examples.reportedOutcome: Customer story reports over one million daily live calls across nine Indian languages; roughly 97% of its STT calls use transliteration.
examples.limitation: Scale is customer-reported. Screening workflow should not silently intercept urgent medical calls.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Offer a clear human takeover and summary; don't force every user through a rigid language form.

examples.name: SLNG Indic voice infrastructure
examples.problem: Voice platforms need Indic speech and regional processing.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Saaras STT and Bulbul TTS in SLNG's production cascade.
examples.generativeMechanism: Speech recognition; independently chosen LLM layer; generated speech.
examples.workflow: SLNG routes voice workloads through Indic STT and TTS while managing execution and region.
examples.reportedOutcome: Case study reports about one million API requests monthly. Larger future workloads are plans, not achieved usage.
examples.limitation: In-region processing claims do not establish Sahara's contract, retention policy or clinical safety.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Choose speech and reasoning independently; benchmark the full voice turn rather than a single model score.

examples.name: Dezerv post-call analytics and live notes
examples.evidencePublisher: Sarvam, with Dezerv co-founder attribution and explicit internal-data disclaimer
examples.problem: Long multilingual adviser conversations are hard to search.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Sarvam SDK and Speech to Text Batch API with speaker diarization.
examples.generativeMechanism: Speaker-separated transcript supports searchable relationship history and downstream analytics.
examples.workflow: Consent; transcribe calls/video; retain who said what and when; advisers revisit concerns and goals.
examples.reportedOutcome: Dezerv reports about 360,000 speech minutes in the preceding month and around 20% lower word error rate versus its previous setup.
examples.limitation: Internal results; zero-retention configuration is specific to that deployment and cannot be assumed for a new account.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Goals-of-care history must retain speaker, date and source so preferences are not flattened into an unattributed AI summary.

examples.name: Supernova — Nova AI spoken English tutor
examples.problem: Accent errors and code-switching interrupt spoken practice.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Speech-to-Text API in translate mode; specific model version unspecified.
examples.generativeMechanism: Indic utterances become English text for Nova's feedback/conversation system; English is transcribed directly.
examples.workflow: Learner speaks and may switch languages; transcription/translation feeds feedback and continued practice.
examples.reportedOutcome: Customer story reports latency reduced to 550–650 ms, error rates halved, and five-to-eight percentage-point better scenario completion.
examples.limitation: Internal product metrics; source still reports roughly 19% word error rate, which is unsuitable as a blanket medical-accuracy assurance.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Let families code-switch, but review medicine names, doses, negation and distress language instead of trusting ordinary transcription quality.

examples.name: UIDAI / Aadhaar resident voice agents
examples.problem: Accessible resident feedback and verification across language and literacy levels.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Full-stack GenAI platform deployed on-premise inside UIDAI's air-gapped environment.
examples.generativeMechanism: Local model, inference, orchestration and interaction logic support spoken service workflows.
examples.workflow: Voice interaction for enrolment feedback, suspicious-activity alerts and pensioner/senior support.
examples.reportedOutcome: Case study reports four-plus deployed use cases and around four crore residents served.
examples.limitation: Vendor/customer report; a specially hosted government deployment does not mean ordinary public Sarvam API use is air-gapped.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: If hospitals require stricter data control, assess a contracted deployment rather than describing every cloud API as private by default.

examples.name: Ekatra Foundation Gujarati literature pipeline
examples.problem: Historical Gujarati scans contain complex typography and archaic terms.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Specialized layout, recognition and proofreading document pipeline; exact model identifiers unspecified.
examples.generativeMechanism: Layout-aware extraction plus contextual text reconstruction and instruction-driven proofreading.
examples.workflow: Scan; identify structure; recognize blocks; human proofreads; publish formatted ePub.
examples.reportedOutcome: Case study reports improvement from about one error per line to one every ten pages for mainstream books.
examples.limitation: Fifty thousand books is a target, not completed volume. Historical-literature accuracy does not verify handwritten prescription accuracy.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Preserve document layout and original evidence; make extracted text correctable before it becomes a care record.

examples.name: SBI Life multilingual WhatsApp sales assistant
examples.productUrlNote: Internal frontline WhatsApp assistant; public access endpoint not verified.
examples.problem: A large frontline team needs product information in local languages.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Sarvam AI multilingual WhatsApp assistant; precise model names unspecified.
examples.generativeMechanism: Question answering and personalized collateral generation, with calculation/guideline access.
examples.workflow: Sales agent asks within WhatsApp; assistant retrieves product or underwriting information and produces support material.
examples.reportedOutcome: Case study reports deployment to 350,000-plus frontline agents in eleven languages.
examples.limitation: No independent productivity measurement adopted; calculator outputs should not be assumed to be LLM arithmetic.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: A staff-facing assistant can place approved care guidance beside daily workflow; keep calculations deterministic and sources visible.

examples.name: Tata Capital multilingual customer voice agents
examples.evidencePublisher: Sarvam, with Tata Capital CDO attribution
examples.problem: High-volume customer contact across language segments.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Samvaad enterprise voice platform.
examples.generativeMechanism: Contextual voice conversations recognize intent and mixed-language speech with workflow controls.
examples.workflow: Automated conversation in English or ten Indian languages; nuanced interactions transfer to human agents.
examples.reportedOutcome: Case study says a significant share of calling is handled through voice AI; no numerical outcome is adopted.
examples.limitation: Qualitative enterprise claims; empathy descriptions are not evidence that AI can handle serious distress safely.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Route judgement-heavy or emotional conversations to people with the transcript and existing record.

examples.name: Ministry of Agriculture — Digital Crop Survey verification
examples.productUrlNote: Programme pilot; no separate public product endpoint verified.
examples.problem: Administrative crop records need confirmation by the farmer.
examples.actualSarvamComponent: Multilingual telephony voice agents with WhatsApp follow-up.
examples.generativeMechanism: Conversations ask people to confirm or correct existing structured data.
examples.workflow: Call farmer; compare crop/acreage details; capture corrections; target mismatches for field follow-up.
examples.reportedOutcome: Source reports more than 400,000 farmers across four states during the October 2025 pilot.
examples.limitation: Eight crore farmers was a future target, not a verified delivered total. Data verification is not proof of clinical record correctness.
examples.relevantSaharaLesson: Read back existing care information and let patients correct it, instead of repeatedly asking them to fill the same form.
